name: Sucre (Bolivia)
description: A white field charged with a red ragged saltire — the Cross of Burgundy — and a gold ducal crown at the centre.
history: The 'flag of Chuquisaca and Sucre', shared by the department and its capital, revives the Burgundy cross of the colonial Audiencia de Charcas with the crown of the city's arms. Its specifications were set by Municipal Law 124 of 2018 and its use mandated by a 2020 municipal law; it replaced a white flag with a red cross that had been used by the city.

features.symbolism: the Real Audiencia de Charcas and the city's Spanish colonial origins

features.role: ducal crown from the city arms
